text:
Europe/Athens is UTC+2 in summer (EEST).  
Europe/Paris is UTC+2 in summer (CEST) in modern times, but in 1211, time zones didn’t exist; both places used local solar time.  
Longitude difference: Athens ~23.7°E, Paris ~2.4°E → ~21.3° difference → ~1h25m earlier solar time in Paris.  
4:00 in Athens solar time → 4:00 - 1h25 ≈ 2:35 in Paris solar time on same date.  

FINAL_ANSWER: August 6, 1211, 02:35
